checks.summary: the files are exactly those bundle.json lists, sizes match, within the size caps
every file's sha256 equals bundle.json files[]; canonical bundle.json; run_hash recomputes
bundle, manifest, result and every facts/rolls/events/fights line match their schemas; bundle.json's fields and attempt.cell agree with the manifest
not a pilot, valid, no invalid_reason, not a holdout scenario
released suite; harness/bench versions, scenario digest and start save match it
game build, bg3le sha256, mod sha1 and (if pinned) the code's sha1 equal the suite's pins; repo not dirty
prompt sha256 and tool allowlist sha256 equal the condition's
the tool list names equal the allowlist, its definitions the release's; served texts hash to prompt.parts
caps, seed (and seed applied) and difficulty equal the scenario's
the events' model is the manifest's slug; the served effort is the declared one
no submission with this bundle hash; no accepted one by this user and run id
the events are not a near-copy of another submission's
the first facts snapshot matches the scenario's start-state fingerprint
run_start and run_end marks; wall_s equals their distance; events lie between
loads match load_game calls; trades and party kills follow the agent's tool calls
the rolls agree with the facts; luck recomputed equals result.luck
tokens equal the events' usage; cost within 25 % of the recomputed
no resumed process counted twice; first_stop_s consistent with the events
the outcome is not far outside the verified distribution
the graders over the submitted facts give the result's verdict, time and score
deaths and reloads equal the facts' party losses and load marks
the fairness audit over the tool results shows no leak and agrees with the result
no tool outside the allowlist; no load_game without the reloads condition
the YouTube video resolves, its title has the run id, embedding is allowed
the video's duration equals render.json's span, which equals wall_s
render.json is for this run_hash; its (file, seq) events exist, monotone, in the video
frames.tar holds only frames/<n>.jpg within its cap, one decodable frame per 30 s
no home path, e-mail, Steam ID, key shape or .env value in any file
no hidden reasoning in the events
bundle.json names a ticket (F03 holds its id, nonce, root and lines to the schema)
the ticket exists, is the submitter's, its cell equals the bundle's, the nonce is the server's, no other reserving submission holds it
root and lines recompute from the bundle's files; every stream is named and ends in a complete line
every stored beat's root recomputes at its line counts under the server's nonce; counts never fall or pass the file; the end's root is the bundle's
the lines' times fit the server's: clock offset, a start after issue, no stale beat, a watched wall_s, no line past expiry
at most half the run is outside beat range
no gap between beats over 300 s
